units.source_text: 且说妹尼僧从前赘的女婿，现已升任中将。

en.t: Now, the man who had once married into the younger nun's family had been promoted to lieutenant general.

units.source_text: 他的弟弟是个禅师，拜僧都为师父，此时随师父闭居在山中修道。

en.t: His younger brother was a Zen monk who had taken the Sozu as his teacher and was now secluded with him in the mountains, practicing the Way.

units.source_text: 诸兄弟常常上山去访问他。

en.t: The brothers often went up into the mountains to visit him.

units.source_text: 从京都到横川，必须道经小野，这一天中将便顺路来此访问。

en.t: Since the road from the capital to Yokawa had to pass through Ono, the lieutenant general came to visit on his way that day.

units.source_text: 听见开路喝道之声，浮舟远远望见一个相貌堂堂的男子走进山庄来。

en.t: Hearing the cries of the attendants clearing the way, Ukifune saw from a distance a handsome, dignified man entering the mountain villa.

units.source_text: 她就回想起从前薰大将悄悄地来访宇治山庄时的情景，历历如在目前。

en.t: It brought back to her, as vividly as if before her eyes, the time when Captain Kaoru had secretly visited the villa at Uji.

units.source_text: 这小野山庄也是一个非常荒凉寂寞的住处。

en.t: This villa at Ono, too, was an exceedingly desolate and lonely dwelling.

units.source_text: 然而在这里住惯的人，也安排得非常雅洁。

en.t: Yet those who were used to living there had arranged it with remarkable grace and purity.

units.source_text: 墙根的瞿麦花开得很美丽，女郎花和桔梗也开始开花了。

en.t: The pinks at the foot of the wall were blooming beautifully, and the maiden flowers and bellflowers had also begun to blossom.

units.source_text: 中将带了许多穿各种各样旅行服装的青年男子，自己也穿旅装，走进这院子里来。

en.t: The lieutenant general entered the courtyard with many young men dressed in various kinds of traveling clothes, and he himself was dressed for travel as well.

units.source_text: 侍女请他在南面就座。

en.t: A maid invited him to sit on the south side.

units.source_text: 中将坐在那里眺望一下庭院景色。

en.t: The lieutenant general sat there and looked out for a while over the garden scenery.

units.source_text: 他的年纪大约二十七八，看来是个老成持重、深通世故的人。

en.t: He seemed to be about twenty-seven or twenty-eight, a composed and steady man well versed in the ways of the world.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧在纸隔扇旁边立一个帷屏，和他会面。

en.t: The younger nun set up a curtain screen beside the paper sliding partition and met with him there.

units.source_text: 未语先就哭泣，后来说道：“年月易积，往日情景愈觉隔远了。

en.t: Before she could speak she began to weep, and then she said, "The years pile up so easily, and the scenes of the past feel ever more distant.

units.source_text: 贤婿不忘旧谊，至今犹蒙枉顾，实为山乡增光，至深欣感。

en.t: That you, my worthy son-in-law, have not forgotten our old bond and still deign to visit us brings honor to this mountain village, and I am deeply grateful.

units.source_text: 却又觉得此乃一段奇缘。”

en.t: And yet I cannot help feeling that this is a strange and wondrous bond."

units.source_text: 中将同情这尼僧岳母的苦心，答道：“往日情景，无时不在思念之中。

en.t: The lieutenant general, moved by the painstaking feelings of his nun mother-in-law, replied, "The scenes of former days are never absent from my thoughts.

units.source_text: 只因尊处隔离尘俗，故而未敢常来叨扰。

en.t: It is only because your dwelling is removed from the dust of the world that I have not dared to come often and trouble you.

units.source_text: 舍弟入山修道，私心实甚羡慕，故常前往探视。

en.t: My younger brother has entered the mountains to practice the Way, and in my heart I truly envy him, so I often go to see him.

units.source_text: 然每次入山，往往有人请求挈带同行，以致未便造访。

en.t: But whenever I go into the mountains, someone usually asks to accompany me, and so it has not been convenient to call on you.

units.source_text: 今日一概谢绝，故能前来晋谒也。”

en.t: Today I declined them all, and that is why I have been able to come pay my respects."

units.source_text: 尼僧岳母说：“你说羡慕入山修道，反而蹈袭了时下流行之语。

en.t: His nun mother-in-law said, "When you say you envy entering the mountains to practice, you are only repeating a fashionable phrase of the day.

units.source_text: 若言不忘昔日之旧谊，不随浇薄之世俗，则感谢不尽矣。”

en.t: If you were to say that you have not forgotten our old ties and do not follow the shallow ways of the world, then I would be grateful beyond measure."

units.source_text: 便用泡饭等物招待随从人等，请中将吃的是莲子之类的东西。

en.t: She then entertained the attendants with soaked rice and the like, while offering the lieutenant general things such as lotus seeds.

units.source_text: 中将也因这是从前惯住的地方，觉得受此招待不须客气。

en.t: Because this was a place where he had once been used to living, the lieutenant general felt no need to stand on ceremony in accepting her hospitality.

units.source_text: 忽然天上降下阵雨，把客人留住，岳母女婿两人便从容叙谈。

en.t: Suddenly a shower fell from the sky and kept the guest there, so mother-in-law and son-in-law were able to converse at leisure.
